body.x: DABIDA Corp. (CEO Lee Eunseung) participated in CES 2023, the global IT and home appliance exhibition, which ran from the 5th (local time) to the 8th of January 2023. Marking its third consecutive appearance, DABIDA showcased GENICLASS and GENIPEN at the Eureka Park - CES's startup exhibition hall - AI ZONE.

DABIDA, an Edutech startup selected as TIPS in 2019, recently signed a contract with Megastudy, the No. 1 education company in Korea, at this CES exhibition. Focusing on GENIPEN, a Digilog (digital + analog) product, GENIBOT, an all-in-one educational robot, and GENIVRWARE, a VR content authoring solution that allows users to create and experience virtual reality, they plan to spread K-EDU.

DABIDA presented its solution of a new blended education that combines the advantages of online and offline, optimized for the neverending post-covid era. As the solution connects offline educational experiences online, users can obtain high-quality education anytime, anywhere. DABIDA expects that this solution will contribute to education quality and educational equity, one of the 17 sustainable development goals set by the UN.

"It is meaningful to announce DABIDA's technology and educational innovation at CES, which introduces the world's latest technology," said Lee Eunseung, CEO of DABIDA. "As we met with Ecuador EDINUN last year and signed a $430,000 contract last year, we want to become an Edutech company that can promote K-EDU, not only in Latin America but also in the Middle East and Europe."
DABIDA was selected and recognized for its technology and potential for overseas markets.
